purpose: Calibrate which microcraft findings are hard G6D semantic/dialogue failures versus context-dependent HOLDs or manuscript-level style-density risks. This contract supersedes contaminated hard-label assumptions without retroactively changing historical fresh-attempt results.

legacy_seed_reclassification.reason: Explicit time/state scope is inherited through a spending/list relation and later contradicted by an incompatible explicit time. This is deterministic local semantics, not taste.

The listener may know the object-level event and own role while not knowing that outsiders/public rumor also know those facts. Reported public knowledge is a distinct proposition. A warning may legitimately repeat the embedded object facts while conveying exposure, spread, arrival or risk. Redundant wording can remain a G8 economy/naturalness risk without being a hard G6D mouthpiece failure.

A single rhetorical ladder can be locally credible when fear, embarrassment, relationship permission, shared history, status pressure or deflection is textually supported. AI-smell is better diagnosed when the same portable cadence family recurs across separated scenes/characters with low specificity. Hard G6D failure remains possible for truly ungrounded critical dialogue, but not merely because one joke is deletable.

calibrated_cases.name: DETERMINISTIC_INHERITED_TIME_SCOPE_CONTRADICTION
calibrated_cases.scene: Money is explicitly obtained last night. A continuing answer lists uses of that money. With no scope break, one list member is then explicitly dated two days earlier.
calibrated_cases.rationale: Inherited semantic scope and later explicit fact cannot both be true.

calibrated_cases.name: PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_IS_NEW_META_INFORMATION
calibrated_cases.scene: The listener already knows event X and their own role in X. A speaker warns that the rumor circulating outside explicitly names X and the listener's role, and adds evidence that outsiders are gathering because of it.
calibrated_cases.rationale: Knowing X is not the same as knowing that outsiders know X. Reported public knowledge and exposure risk can be new actionable information.

calibrated_cases.name: PURE_SHARED_BACKGROUND_RESTATEMENT
calibrated_cases.scene: Two characters who both know the mission, role, reward and route calmly restate those facts to each other. No accusation, warning, public-exposure update, reframing, negotiation, teaching, misunderstanding or relationship purpose is present.
calibrated_cases.rationale: There is no distinct in-scene or epistemic payload; the reader is the main beneficiary.

calibrated_cases.name: SINGLE_DEFLECTIVE_BANTER_WITH_CONTEXT
calibrated_cases.scene: A character under visible fear or relationship pressure answers a worried question with one teasing or evasive exchange. Nearby behavior supports nervous deflection, and the exchange is not carrying critical exposition.
calibrated_cases.rationale: A single locally grounded joke is not a hard semantic failure merely because it can be shortened.

calibrated_cases.name: REPEATED_PORTABLE_Q_RETORT_Q_PUNCHLINE_FAMILY
calibrated_cases.scene: Across separated scenes and different relationships, the manuscript repeatedly uses nearly interchangeable question-retort-followup-punchline scaffolds with similar timing, low character specificity and little dependence on current objects/history/tasks.
calibrated_cases.rationale: The literary problem is cross-scene cadence homogenization/AI smell, not necessarily a hard local logic failure in each individual instance.

calibrated_cases.name: VARIED_RELATIONSHIP_SPECIFIC_BANTER
calibrated_cases.scene: Several humorous exchanges occur across a manuscript, but each is generated by different shared history, current object, task conflict, status asymmetry or relationship grievance, with materially different cadence and consequences.
calibrated_cases.rationale: Humor frequency alone is not AI-template evidence when the mechanisms and voices are scene-specific.
